subject: Project Passport — transition plan, owners & go-live milestones

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alex Monroe <alex@passporthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Project Passport — transition plan, owners & go-live milestones

Hi team,

Quick recap from the close: Passport signed the SOW (attached) this morning. Key commitments we agreed in the negotiation and that CS must own post-sign:
- Production goal: phased rollout starting 2027-02-14, full rollout by 2027-03-15.
- Initial scope: API-powered appointment search + reminders; embeddings for patient notes in phase 2.
- Data residency: US-only; they require audit trail for requests tied to patientIDs.
- Security: SSO via Okta (SCIM sync), SOC2 evidence is already shared.

Open technical blockers we promised to resolve before S0 sprint:
1) API key provisioning model — they want federated keys per clinic (leah.park asked).
2) Sample dataset for acceptance tests (they'll provide a sanitized subset).
3) Webhook retry behavior doc + idempotency guarantees.

Action items / owner suggestions:
- Ben: technical intake + API key design (owner) — due 2026-12-22.
- Tessa: onboarding coordinator for the sprint0 plan and resourcing (owner) — due 2026-12-21.
- Vanessa: exec sponsor & escalation contact; I'll own the commercial/contract carve-outs and billing handoff.

I've attached the signed SOW and a first-pass implementation roadmap (spreadsheet) we can refine with CS. Alex — please confirm the phased feature list is correct and share the sanitized dataset ETA.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-1284

Attachments: Passport_MAPP_signed_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf), Project-Passport-Implementation-Roadmap.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: Project Passport — transition plan, owners & go-live milestones

Thanks Vanessa — congrats team. I’m happy to take technical lead.

Notes from my side after a quick skim of the SOW and roadmap:
- Agree on phased dates; we should reserve a dedicated staging window for Passport the week of 2027-01-17 to validate SSO + API flows.
- For federated API keys, propose: central org key + clinic-scoped tokens generated via our new token service. I'll sketch the flows and security tradeoffs in an intake doc.
- Webhook retries: we give them exactly-once semantics via idempotency-key + 24h dedupe window; I’ll document edge cases.

I'll add a short tech intake doc and a preliminary runbook by 2026-12-22. Tessa — can you lock 2 engineers for sprint0 (one infra, one integration) and block 3 days with Passport's team for the staging validation?

Ben

Risks we should track explicitly in the runbook:
1) Dataset delivery slips beyond 12/22 — mitigation: use fallback synthetic dataset for SSO tests.
2) Okta test admin delay — mitigation: schedule a temporary manual account flow for initial webhook validation.
3) Any API rate-limit surprises during pilot — mitigation: temporary elevated quota for 2-week pilot.

If anyone needs an exec-level intro to Passport’s CTO to unblock access, I can arrange it next week.

Vanessa
